definitions.explanation: The sound or manner of drinking thirstily in large swallows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ごくごく⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
ごくごく⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てて→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{渇|かわ}いて→渇く：10965_kawaku⟧ごくごく⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I was thirsty and gulped it down.

notes:
ごくごく is an onomatopoeia representing the sound and action of gulping liquid thirstily.

USAGE:
Typically used with ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) to express drinking in large swallows.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ごくごく⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to gulp down
- ごくごくと⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink gulp by gulp
- ごくごく⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to make gulping sounds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちびちび→ちびちび：05778_chibichibi⟧: sipping little by little (opposite)
- ごくんと: with one gulp (single swallow)

RELATED ONOMATOPOEIA:
- がぶがぶ: also gulping, but emphasizes greediness

cross_references.label: gurgling (sound of water draining or bubbling out)
